issue.title: Flaky test_run_supervisor_idle_timeout_fires_after_output_stalls exceeds 5s no-hang bound
issue.description:
tests/monitor/test_monitor_supervise.py::test_run_supervisor_idle_timeout_fires_after_output_stalls failed under an escalated full just check (workspace sase_19, 2026-08-16, 6 xdist workers, 31161 items) with:

  assert 5.825556540999969 < 5.0
  at `assert elapsed < _NO_HANG_TIMEOUT`

The supervisor DID fire the idle timeout (`exit_status == 1` passed). The child is `sh -c 'echo started; sleep 30'` with `idle_timeout_seconds=0.2` and `timeout_seconds=30.0`. Under a contended full parallel lane the whole `run_supervisor()` call took 5.83s against `_NO_HANG_TIMEOUT = 5.0`.

This session did not touch monitor supervision or that test file — it only added reserved `lease(...)` RUNNING-field labels. Isolated rerun of the session's own tests passed (38 passed).

SCOPE: reproduce under a contended full parallel lane. The idle-timeout contract itself held; the flake is the 5.0s wall-clock bound around a 0.2s idle timeout. Related but not the same defect as closed sase-lk (different nodes whose pipe does not EOF promptly).

payload.entry: RELATED: sase-lk — closed after a BoundedLogPipe.close() join-timeout fix for three other tests/monitor/test_monitor_supervise.py nodes (term_ignoring_chatty_child, times_out_after_partial_line, completes_when_grandchild_holds_stdout). Same file and same 5.0s _NO_HANG_TIMEOUT bound, but this bead is a different node (idle_timeout_fires_after_output_stalls) whose idle-timeout contract held and only the wall-clock bound failed under load.

evidence.note: Independent recurrence on 2026-08-16: a 13-worker full just check triggered by an unrelated test-file split failed test_run_supervisor_idle_timeout_fires_after_output_stalls; the immediate isolated rerun passed. This session touches only tests/ace/tui/test_agent_completion*.py.

Independent observation while landing epic sase-ns.6 at HEAD 6000a54a1 (workspace sase_14, 2026-08-17): 'just selection-health --fail-on-new-flake' still names tests/monitor/test_monitor_supervise.py::test_run_supervisor_idle_timeout_fires_after_output_stalls as a reproducible flake above tests/reproducible_flake_baseline.txt, after the epic retired the nine sase-nv config nodes and the sase-md config-center node. The durable store's failure records for this node come from distinct workspaces with disjoint changed-file sets, which is exactly the evidence shape the gate requires, so it is not a single-run blip. Proposed as a PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP by phase sase-ns.6.1; this bead already covers it, so no new task was created.
